audit_status.source_base: Greek Galatians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for urgent opening, no rival good news, human approval, apocalypse/calling of Jesus Messiah, former zeal, Arabia/Damascus/Jerusalem narrative.

verses.restored: Paul, apostle not from humans nor through a human, but through Jesus Messiah and Divine Father, who raised him from the dead,

familiar.text: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

modern.text: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead—

original.text: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος, οὐκ ἀπʼ ἀνθρώπων οὐδὲ διʼ ἀνθρώπου ἀλλὰ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ θεοῦ πατρὸς τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν,

verses.restored: and all the siblings with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

familiar.text: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

modern.text: and all the brothers with me, To the churches of Galatia:

original.text: καὶ οἱ σὺν ἐμοὶ πάντες ἀδελφοί, ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Γαλατίας·

verses.restored: Grace to you and peace from Divine our Father and Lord Jesus Messiah,

familiar.text: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

modern.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,

original.text: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ⸂καὶ κυρίου ἡμῶν⸃ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,

verses.restored: who gave himself for our sins/misalignments, so that he might rescue us from the present harmful age, according to the will of our Divine and Father,

familiar.text: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

modern.text: who gave Himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,

original.text: τοῦ δόντος ἑαυτὸν ⸀ὑπὲρ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν ὅπως ἐξέληται ἡμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ ⸂αἰῶνος τοῦ ἐνεστῶτος⸃ πονηροῦ κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ πατρὸς ἡμῶν,

verses.restored: to whom be glory into the ages of the ages. Amen.

familiar.text: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

modern.text: to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen. No Other Gospel

original.text: ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.

verses.restored: I marvel that you are so quickly being transferred from the One who called you in the grace of Messiah to a different good news,

familiar.text: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

modern.text: I am amazed how quickly you are deserting the One who called you by the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—

original.text: Θαυμάζω ὅτι οὕτως ταχέως μετατίθεσθε ἀπὸ τοῦ καλέσαντος ὑμᾶς ἐν χάριτι Χριστοῦ εἰς ἕτερον εὐαγγέλιον,

verses.restored: which is not another; except there are some troubling you and wanting to distort the good news of Messiah.

familiar.text: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

modern.text: which is not even a gospel. Evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.

original.text: ὃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλο· εἰ μή τινές εἰσιν οἱ ταράσσοντες ὑμᾶς καὶ θέλοντες μεταστρέψαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: But even if we or a messenger from heaven should announce good news to you beyond what we announced to you, let that one be devoted to judgment.

familiar.text: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

modern.text: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be under a curse!

original.text: ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐὰν ἡμεῖς ἢ ἄγγελος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ⸀εὐαγγελίζηται ⸀ὑμῖν παρʼ ὃ εὐηγγελισάμεθα ὑμῖν, ἀνάθεμα ἔστω.

verses.restored: As we have said before, and now again I say: if anyone announces good news to you beyond what you received, let that one be devoted to judgment.

familiar.text: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

modern.text: As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be under a curse! Paul Preaches the Gospel

original.text: ὡς προειρήκαμεν, καὶ ἄρτι πάλιν λέγω, εἴ τις ὑμᾶς εὐαγγελίζεται παρʼ ὃ παρελάβετε, ἀνάθεμα ἔστω.

verses.restored: For now am I persuading humans or the Divine? Or am I seeking to please humans? If I were still pleasing humans, I would not be servant of Messiah.

familiar.text: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

modern.text: Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

original.text: Ἄρτι γὰρ ἀνθρώπους πείθω ἢ τὸν θεόν; ἢ ζητῶ ἀνθρώποις ἀρέσκειν; ⸀εἰ ἔτι ἀνθρώποις ἤρεσκον, Χριστοῦ δοῦλος οὐκ ἂν ἤμην.

verses.restored: For I make known to you, siblings, the good news announced by me, that it is not according to human.

familiar.text: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

modern.text: For I certify to you, brothers, that the gospel I preached was not devised by man.

original.text: Γνωρίζω ⸀γὰρ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν ὑπʼ ἐμοῦ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν κατὰ ἄνθρωπον·

verses.restored: For I neither received it from a human nor was taught it, but through an unveiling/apocalypse of Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

modern.text: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.

original.text: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἐγὼ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου παρέλαβον αὐτό, ⸀οὔτε ἐδιδάχθην, ἀλλὰ διʼ ἀποκαλύψεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: For you heard of my former conduct in Judaism, that beyond measure I pursued/persecuted the assembly of the Divine and ravaged it,

familiar.text: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

modern.text: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how severely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.

original.text: Ἠκούσατε γὰρ τὴν ἐμὴν ἀναστροφήν ποτε ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ, ὅτι καθʼ ὑπερβολὴν ἐδίωκον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐπόρθουν αὐτήν,

verses.restored: and I advanced in Judaism beyond many of my own age among my people, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

familiar.text: And profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

modern.text: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

original.text: καὶ προέκοπτον ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ ὑπὲρ πολλοὺς συνηλικιώτας ἐν τῷ γένει μου, περισσοτέρως ζηλωτὴς ὑπάρχων τῶν πατρικῶν μου παραδόσεων.

verses.restored: But when the Divine, the One who set me apart from my mother's womb and called me through his grace, was pleased

familiar.text: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,

modern.text: But when God, who set me apart from my mother’s womb and called me by His grace, was pleased

original.text: ὅτε δὲ ⸀εὐδόκησεν ὁ ἀφορίσας με ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου καὶ καλέσας διὰ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ

verses.restored: to unveil his Son in me, so that I might announce him as good news among the nations, immediately I did not consult flesh and blood,

familiar.text: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

modern.text: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not rush to consult with flesh and blood,

original.text: ἀποκαλύψαι τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ ἵνα εὐαγγελίζωμαι αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, εὐθέως οὐ προσανεθέμην σαρκὶ καὶ αἵματι,

verses.restored: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia and again returned to Damascus.

familiar.text: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

modern.text: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to the apostles who came before me, but I went into Arabia and later returned to Damascus.

original.text: οὐδὲ ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα πρὸς τοὺς πρὸ ἐμοῦ ἀποστόλους, ἀλλὰ ἀπῆλθον εἰς Ἀραβίαν, καὶ πάλιν ὑπέστρεψα εἰς Δαμασκόν.

verses.restored: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas, and I remained with him fifteen days.

familiar.text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

modern.text: Only after three years did I go up to Jerusalem to confer with Cephas, and I stayed with him fifteen days.

original.text: Ἔπειτα μετὰ ⸂ἔτη τρία⸃ ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἱστορῆσαι ⸀Κηφᾶν, καὶ ἐπέμεινα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡμέρας δεκαπέντε·

verses.restored: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the brother of the Lord.

familiar.text: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.

modern.text: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord’s brother.

original.text: ἕτερον δὲ τῶν ἀποστόλων οὐκ εἶδον, εἰ μὴ Ἰάκωβον τὸν ἀδελφὸν τοῦ κυρίου.

verses.restored: Now what I write to you, look, before the Divine, I do not lie.

familiar.text: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

modern.text: I assure you before God that what I am writing to you is no lie.

original.text: ἃ δὲ γράφω ὑμῖν, ἰδοὺ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ ὅτι οὐ ψεύδομαι.

verses.restored: Then I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

familiar.text: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

modern.text: Later I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

original.text: ἔπειτα ἦλθον εἰς τὰ κλίματα τῆς Συρίας καὶ τῆς Κιλικίας.

verses.restored: But I was unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea that are in Messiah.

familiar.text: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:

modern.text: I was personally unknown, however, to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.

original.text: ἤμην δὲ ἀγνοούμενος τῷ προσώπῳ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Ἰουδαίας ταῖς ἐν Χριστῷ,

verses.restored: They were only hearing: The one formerly pursuing/persecuting us now announces as good news the trust he once ravaged.

familiar.text: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

modern.text: They only heard the account: “The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.”

original.text: μόνον δὲ ἀκούοντες ἦσαν ὅτι Ὁ διώκων ἡμᾶς ποτε νῦν εὐαγγελίζεται τὴν πίστιν ἥν ποτε ἐπόρθει,

verses.restored: And they glorified the Divine in me.

familiar.text: And they glorified God in me.

modern.text: And they glorified God because of me.

original.text: καὶ ἐδόξαζον ἐν ἐμοὶ τὸν θεόν.

translation_notes: Apokalypsis in verse 12 is rendered unveiling/apocalypse to preserve revelatory force.
Paul's critique of his former zeal is autobiographical and rhetorical; it should not become contempt for Judaism or Jewish tradition.
